runs: א. Benzodiazepines as first line, to secure sedation and prevent line removal
ב. IV antipsychotic (haloperidol), with slow dose titration until effect, to avoid restraint ←

Book: p889: benzodiazepines are not first-line for delirium (except seizures or withdrawal); low-dose haloperidol is the dosing the text gives, titrated to effect, and the IV route is for monitored settings (this patient is in the ICU). The stem has him on a breathing tube, and p889 reports that trials of dexmedetomidine in ventilated ICU patients found shorter delirium and ICU stay, which is likely why ד was also accepted on appeal. p888: physical restraints should be avoided. Both ב and ד were accepted after appeals.
